summary: Frontend-only verification of two new UI additions: (1) Global DM button next to NotificationBell on Feed/Discover/Profile/Log headers and (2) 'New post to this group' CTA on Group Details page. All checks passed with reese@teebox.demo.
verified_flows: Profile header (cover top bar) shows [data-testid=profile-header-messages] alongside [data-testid=profile-notifications]
Tapping the DM button navigates to /messages (verified on Feed tab)
Group Details page (/groups/{id}) renders new CTA [data-testid=group-new-post] labelled 'New post to this group' below 'Group chat' CTA
Tapping 'New post to this group' navigates to /log?groupId=<id> and lands on [data-testid=log-round-screen]

On the Log screen, the target group's share pill [data-testid=log-share-group-<id>] is pre-selected (bg=brandPrimary rgb(21,128,61)) and 'Everyone' pill is inactive — round will post into the group feed
Regression: Group feed still lists a prior share-to-group post ('Shared to TEST_FE_Group2'), Group chat CTA still works, NotificationBell still renders on all tabs, existing tab navigation intact
No console/runtime errors introduced by DMButton or Group CTA; only pre-existing 'shadow* deprecated' RN-web style warnings observed
critical_code_review_comments: DMButton uses useFocusEffect polling of api.unreadMessageCount() — fine, but consider debouncing when tab-switching rapidly to avoid redundant hits.
log.tsx line 49: two state hooks are declared on the same line (`useState(''); const [courseSelected...` combined). Cosmetic — split for readability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo user reese@teebox.demo (admin) and their existing TEST_FE_Group2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: sign-in-email/sign-in-password/sign-in-submit. Profile tab is reached via header-my-profile CTA on Feed (bottom tab bar has Feed/Discover/Log/More; the More menu also exposes Profile). Group list is at /groups with rows testID=group-row-<id>. Group detail exposes group-new-post and group-open-chat CTAs. Log screen accepts a ?groupId= param and pre-selects the matching log-share-group-<id> pill.
